title: Connect the app to service-backed workspace reads
goal: Move workspace and document reads behind the loopback service so the Vite app no longer relies on static imports for core behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The service returns workspace manifest data and document payloads from Markdown bundles
The Vite app reads the EPP seed workspace through the service
Desktop-only layout remains the validation target
The service response shape preserves future hooks for Git history, audit ledger, proposals, search, and external workspace paths
validation: Smoke the desktop app against the service
notes: Parked as a standalone slice because service-backed workspace and document reads are now mandatory acceptance criteria inside SG-0013.
